annotations.title: Mark a thread read or unread

description: Mark a thread read or unread. read: true marks every message in it read. read: false marks its newest message sent to you unread. It changes here at once, and in the mailbox itself on its next check. A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes changes only the thread's copies in those.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
